Local changes to fst.h (from https://git.iem.at/zmoelnig/FST):
- fstSpeakerArrangement.speakers: flexible array -> speakers[8], because JUCE stores the structure by value.
- fstPinProperties: added 48 bytes of trailing padding so the structure has the 128-byte size hosts allocate.
- fstMidiKeyName.keyName: flexible array -> keyName[64] (kVstMaxNameLen), because JUCE's VST2 host makes one on the stack (MSVC refuses a zero-size array).
